item.title: French procurement agency orders 40 counter-drone systems from MBDA
item.description: France's DGA has placed an order with MBDA for 40 mobile counter-drone systems, according to the French Ministry of the Armed Forces.
item.content:encoded:
France's DGA has placed an order with MBDA for 40 mobile counter-drone systems, according to the French Ministry of the Armed Forces.

The counter-UAS order follows trials earlier this year. Deliveries are due in 2027.

item.title: NATO counter-drone exercise draws record participation
item.description: NATO's counter-drone interoperability exercise brought together systems from 12 nations, a record for the event.
item.content:encoded:
NATO's counter-drone interoperability exercise brought together systems from 12 nations, a record for the event.

Participants tested detection and defeat of small drones in shared scenarios.

item.title: Hypersonic interceptor study wins European Defence Fund backing
item.description: A European study on interceptors against hypersonic glide vehicles will be funded by the European Defence Fund, with MBDA taking part.
item.content:encoded:
A European study on interceptors against hypersonic glide vehicles will be funded by the European Defence Fund, with MBDA taking part.

The work covers guidance and propulsion for the interceptor.
